historical_runtime_caveats: Original references did not record a fixed Python hash seed; this diagnostic fixed PYTHONHASHSEED=0 before worker startup and explicitly checked old-arm replay.
Secondary protocols omit direct thread declarations. Both diagnostic arms use the matched explicit primary CPU settings; historical secondary settings are not invented.
fixed_design.mapping_digest_encoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(source_sha256, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
fixed_design.query_scope: Diverse: 30 distinct public input strings across scaffold/time/target panels. Legacy: 12 main-panel public input strings. Identical generator inputs across pipeline members are deduplicated.

historical_reference_replay.original_630_campaign_status_at_this_eva: Still in progress; original affected asset and all historical outcomes retained. Generator-call success does not replace an original pipeline status.
historical_reference_replay.snapshot_scope: Generator-complete snapshots available at plan creation, not final full-pipeline outcomes.

independent_parent_checks.independence_limit: Independent project-score implementation and output reconstruction; the same RDKit chemistry/perception kernel is shared.
independent_parent_checks.input_pin_check_scope: The 58 input pins were checked before and after the independent parent evaluation, after the generator experiment completed. These are separate from the execution helper's experiment-time verify_plan checks.
independent_parent_checks.score_recalculation: Legacy RDKit AllChem.GetMorganFingerprint radius 2, useChirality=False, useBondTypes=True, useFeatures=False; sparse counts and separate integer sum(min)/sum(max) arithmetic.

limitations: No SynLlama or ReactionT5 inference, synthesis reconstruction, 3D scoring, experimental synthesis or biological validation was rerun. Structural similarity is not activity or synthesis probability.
Equality is observed for the fixed frozen-generator conditions only. It does not establish current develop behavior or full-pipeline equivalence under the 360-second budget.

Old-arm archived replay is supported for 72 conditions; the other 54 lack complete historical references. Neither absent references nor original failed/incomplete pipeline outcomes are recast as successes.
All 126 conditions and 252 calls remain in the denominator. The output observations are dependent across shared inputs, seeds and arms; no inferential superiority estimate is made.
A repaired index can alter candidate reservoirs and tie ordering elsewhere. These equal outputs do not establish equivalence for untested inputs or eliminate the original index defects.
Shared-host wall time and memory are descriptive; this record makes no speedup, full-pipeline wall-budget, global optimality or efficacy claim.
The separate 630-attempt campaign remains historical and incomplete at this evaluation. This record does not certify a corrected full campaign or publication readiness.

observed_execution.asset_attribution: Conditional on the pinned frozen implementation, runtime, inputs, settings and index bytes; no detected output difference on these conditions.
observed_execution.first_two_scope: Equality of the ordered design identities that the frozen configuration would pass downstream. Synthesis, model inference and 3D scoring were not executed in this diagnostic.

provenance.public_bundle_excludes: Raw molecules, full plan/job/member records, output tables, reference snapshots and fingerprint arrays. Absolute local paths identify retained evidence, not publicly downloadable artifacts.

returned_generator_count_similarity.denominator: All returned generator candidate rows in each policy/arm, including repeated observations across seeds and arms; not distinct molecules or independent biological replicates.
returned_generator_count_similarity.interpretation: Diverse exploration permits scores below 0.5; legacy uses a 0.5 floor. These summaries are not the similarity distribution of the configured downstream first two. Fingerprint Tanimoto 1.0 does not establish exact molecular identity.

scope: Paired old-index versus corrected-index calls using the original frozen generator and pinned campaign runtime. This is a local asset-substitution diagnostic, not a rerun of the current develop pipeline or a method efficacy comparison.

verifier_preparation_note.correction_before_final_evaluation: The worker request intentionally redacts campaign members. The parent verifier was corrected to compare the retained public job fields, while separately checking full member coverage in the plan.
